selection_rule: Most fully passing posts, then field checks, then valid outputs, then lowest observed 20-post batch duration
notes: Same 20 frozen inputs, exact prompt, schema, temperature and output-token limit for every model.
Scores are raw outputs before common normalization or header-country review.
The winning model missed one explicit management seniority; the common header-title normalization handles it.
These are development sample checks, not held-out or corpus-wide accuracy estimates.
Batch durations include query overhead and do not predict full-corpus throughput linearly.
